lines.en: label utamaid25p1:
scene utabeforerain1
: Guhhhhhhhhh...
: Why does being cute have to be so exhausting, Master? All of this adorableness is giving me a headache.
lines.zh: : 为什么可爱起来会这么累啊，Master？这一身的可爱都让我头疼了。

lines.en: : As much as I appreciate still being called “Master” after the cafe has closed, I feel like I should remind you that you’re not really {i}obligated{/i} to say that anymore.
lines.zh: : 虽然咖啡厅都打烊了您还叫我“Master”，我挺受用的，不过我觉得该提醒您一句，您其实{i}不必{/i}非这么叫了。

lines.en: : Right, sorry. It’s hard to get out of character while I’m still wearing the outfit- even if I’ve already started taking it apart.
lines.zh: : 对，抱歉。只要还穿着这身衣服，就很难出戏——哪怕我已经开始把它一件件拆下来了。

lines.en: : Feel free to continue taking it apart if that helps you relax. No sense in removing the sleeves if you’re going to keep the top on, right?
lines.zh: : 要是能让您放松，尽管继续拆。光把袖子拆了、上衣还穿着，也没什么意义吧？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain2
: Even {i}if{/i} I took the rest off, it’s not like I’ve got the energy to get freaky right now. Being with Uta-chan in this state would be no better than being with some kinda puppet or...a sock.
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i}我把剩下的都脱了，我现在也没那个精力去疯。跟这个状态下的 Uta 酱在一起，跟跟个木偶或者……一只袜子在一起没两样。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve ever been this attracted to a sock before.
lines.zh: : 我好像还从来没对一只袜子这么上心过。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain3
: Yeah, yeah. Save it for the Uta-chan who’s in the mood to flirt back. Right now, I just wanna fall into bed and die.
lines.zh: : 是是是。这话留给那个有心情跟您调情的 Uta 酱吧。现在我只想倒进被窝里死掉。

lines.en: I wound up overstaying my welcome at the maid cafe long enough to watch Uta slowly shed her professional persona and begin transitioning into a state I rarely see from her.
lines.zh: 我在女仆咖啡厅赖得够久，久到看着 Uta 一点点褪下她的职业人设，开始转入一种我很少在她身上看到的状态。

lines.en: But given just how much money I spent here tonight, I feel like I should at least be {i}offered{/i} some sort of additional service at this point.
lines.zh: 不过考虑到今晚我在这儿花了多少钱，我觉得至少该{i}被提供{/i}点什么附加服务才对。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I have accepted by now that those sorts of services are not offered here. Nor do I believe Uta would be cheap by any stretch of the imagination if they were.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，我早就接受了这里不提供那种服务的事实。而且就算提供，我也不认为 Uta 会便宜到哪儿去。

lines.en: And I am not about to sell my house for a single blowjob from my niece’s coworker.
lines.zh: 我也不打算为了我侄女同事的一次口交就把房子卖了。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain4
: Master...if you carry me back to the dorm...I’ll let you do whatever you want with me...
lines.zh: : Master……如果您背我回宿舍……我想让您对我做什么都行……

lines.en: Nevermind.
lines.zh: 当我没说。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain5
: So easy. And literally right after I told you I wasn’t in the mood to flirt anymore. You’ve got a serious problem.
lines.zh: : 太好骗了。而且就在我刚说完没心情调情之后。您这毛病可不轻。

lines.en: : Stop reminding me. I was just contemplating the idea of selling my house to see what else I could get tonight.
lines.zh: : 别提醒我了。我刚才还在琢磨把房子卖了，看今晚还能再弄到点什么。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain6
: Oh?
: Yeah. I’d tell you more, but you’ve already reiterated the fact that your fun, suggestive banter is a no-go for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我本来想多说点的，不过您已经重申过了，今晚剩下的时间里，您那套有趣的、带暗示的调侃就免了。

lines.en: : Well, that was before there was a whole house involved. I might go an extra mile or two for a permanent place to live.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那可是在牵扯到一整栋房子之前。要是为了一个能永久住的地方，我说不定会多走一两英里。

lines.en: : I’d expect you to go at least ten miles for something of that size.
lines.zh: : 那种体量的东西，我指望您至少走十英里。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain7
: Size doesn’t matter, Master. Stop trying to overcompensate. I’d still love you no matter what size your {i}house{/i} is.
lines.zh: : 大小不重要，Master。别再想着找补了。不管您的{i}房子{/i}多大，我都会一样爱您。

lines.en: : Oh, if you only knew...
lines.zh: : 哦，您要是知道就好了……

lines.en: scene utabeforerain8
: So...what are you still doing here anyway? Was me telling you that we’re about to close a kadrillion times not enough to give you the hint?
lines.zh: : 那么……您到底还在这儿干什么？我都跟您说了无数次要打烊了，还不够让您明白吗？

lines.en: : It was. I just couldn’t stand the thought of being away from you for even a second.
lines.zh: : 够是够。我只是连离开您一秒钟都受不了。

lines.en: : No wonder I’m feeling so exhausted. Being excessively loved really takes it out of a girl, you know?
lines.zh: : 难怪我这么累。被爱得太多真的会把一个女孩掏空的，您知道吗？

lines.en: : I will love you so hard that you’ll go into a coma for the next ten years.
lines.zh: : 我会爱您爱到您接下来十年都昏迷不醒。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain9
: It’s crazy how busy it was tonight, huh?
lines.zh: : 今晚忙成这样，真是疯了，是吧？

lines.en: : Don’t just ignore my amazing pick-up lines.
lines.zh: : 别就这么无视我那绝妙的搭讪台词啊。

lines.en: : Master, you should know by now that no pick-up line will ever work on Uta-chan. Especially not any lines about putting her into a coma.
lines.zh: : Master，您到现在该知道了，什么搭讪台词对 Uta 酱都没用。尤其是那些说什么把她弄昏迷的。

lines.en: : Not even if that coma is a direct result of being aggressively and viciously loved?
lines.zh: : 就算那昏迷是被凶猛又凶狠地爱过之后的直接结果也不行？

lines.en: : You can’t be aggressive and vicious with girls like me until at least the fourth time, Master. I’ve gotta get warmed up first.
lines.zh: : Master，对我这样的女孩，至少得第四次之后您才能凶猛又粗暴。我得先热热身。

lines.en: : How much more money do I have to spend until I can start warming you up?
lines.zh: : 我还得花多少钱，才能开始给您热身？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain10
: How much ya got?
lines.zh: : 您有多少？

lines.en: I drop my wallet onto the table, showing Uta that she has, once again, sucked me dry in the least interesting way possible.
lines.zh: 我把钱包丢在桌上，向 Uta 展示她又一次把我榨干了——而且是用最没意思的方式。

lines.en: : Rough. And here I was about to go the extra...what was it- {i}ten{/i} miles, for just a little bit more.
lines.zh: : 惨。我本来还打算多走那……叫什么来着——{i}十{/i}英里，就为了再多捞一点。

lines.en: : I’d ask you to start logging all of my purchases but I worry about what Ami would do if she ever found out the number.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想让您开始替我记账，可我担心 Ami 要是知道了那个数字会干出什么来。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain9
: Doin’ something like that would just be extra work anyway. And as you can see, maid cafe stuff can be crazy exhausting when business picks up.
lines.zh: : 干那种事本来也就是多出来的活儿。而且您也看到了，生意一好，女仆咖啡厅的活儿能累死人。

lines.en: : I think summer’s gonna be good for us at this rate. And I’m not just saying that because you are singlehandedly financing my college education fund.
lines.zh: : 我觉得照这个势头，夏天对我们来说会很不错。而且我这么说，可不单是因为您在独自资助我的大学教育基金。

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize you were planning on going to college.
lines.zh: : 我都没意识到您还打算上大学。

lines.en: : I might. I haven’t really decided yet.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。我还没真决定。

lines.en: : That is if I can actually get into one, though. As you may have noticed from my transcript, the whole “learning” thing doesn’t really work well for me.
lines.zh: : 不过那得看我到底考不考得上。您大概也从我的成绩单上看出来了，“学习”这回事对我不太管用。

lines.en: : Are you implying that I actually would have gone through the effort to look at your transcript?
lines.zh: : 您是在暗示我还真会费那个劲去看您的成绩单？

lines.en: : Right, right. We can’t all be hard workers. Can we, Master?
lines.zh: : 对对。我们不可能都那么勤奋。是吧，Master？

lines.en: : We certainly can not. But when you think about it, you {i}are{/i} getting a decent chunk of my income. So it’s not like your hard work isn’t exactly rewarded.
lines.zh: : 确实不可能。不过您想想，您{i}确实{/i}拿走了我收入里相当可观的一块。所以您的努力也不是没得到回报。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain7
: The duties of the world’s greatest maid never cease.
lines.zh: : 世界第一女仆的职责，永无止境。

lines.en: : I don’t know. You seem pretty checked out to me.
lines.zh: : 那可不一定。我看您已经心不在焉了。

lines.en: : And yet I’ve still called you “Master” throughout this entire conversation. Uta-chan truly is amazing, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 可我整段对话里还是一直叫您“Master”啊。Uta 酱真是太了不起了，不是吗？

lines.en: : She’d be more amazing if she didn’t treat me the same way she treats all of the other customers when I am clearly the highest bidder for her love.
lines.zh: : 如果她别把我跟其他客人们一视同仁，她会更了不起——明明我显然是为她的爱出价最高的那个。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain6
: You say that as if I wasn’t planning to reward you tonight~
lines.zh: : 您说得好像我今晚没打算犒劳您似的~

lines.en: : You’re {i}not{/i} planning to reward me tonight. That’s just your second wind kicking in as you remind yourself that your sole purpose on this planet is to lead me on.
lines.zh: : 您今晚{i}根本没{/i}打算犒劳我。那只是您的第二阵劲头上来了，顺便提醒自己：您活在这星球上的唯一目的就是吊着我。

lines.en: : That’s my {i}second{/i} purpose. My {i}first{/i} purpose is making you smile.
lines.zh: : 那是我的{i}第二{/i}目的。我的{i}第一{/i}目的是让您笑。

lines.en: : Which is precisely why...
lines.zh: : 正因为如此……

lines.en: : Tonight...and tonight only...
lines.zh: : 今晚……仅限今晚……

lines.en: : I’m going to close up this store...and take you into the back...
lines.zh: : 我要把店关了……然后带您到后面去……

lines.en: : Make sure we’re all alone...where no one will ever find us...
lines.zh: : 确保只剩我们两个……没有人会找到我们的地方……

lines.en: scene utabeforerain11
: And give you an all-inclusive, behind the scenes tour of the secret world of maids!
lines.zh: : 然后带您来一趟全程包办的女仆秘密世界幕后之旅！

lines.en: : Wow, exactly what I wanted.
lines.zh: : 哇，正是我想要的。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain6
: It might not be the inside of my dress, but at least it’s something my parents would approve of! And I know just how much that means to you, Master.
lines.zh: : 虽然不是我裙子的里面，但至少这事儿我爸妈会赞成！而且我知道这对您意义有多大，Master。

lines.en: : Yeah. I guess if you’re ever going to actually give me your hand in marriage, winning them over is going to be kind of necessary.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我想如果您真要把您的手交给我、嫁给我的话，先把他们争取过来还是挺有必要的。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain12
: Hah...hahah...yeah.
lines.zh: : 哈……哈哈……是啊。

lines.en: : Yeah that would, uhh...
lines.zh: : 是啊，那倒是，呃……

lines.en: scene utabeforerain13
: Uhh...anyway! I guess now’s as good a time as any to start this tour thingy, right? Still got a whole store to clean up and...and then I’ve gotta get back to the dorm, so...
lines.zh: : 呃……总之！我想现在开始这趟参观刚刚好，对吧？还有一整个店要打扫，然后……然后我还得回宿舍，所以……

lines.en: : I guess...follow me?
lines.zh: : 那就……跟我来？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain10
: Oh, and don’t think that being alone in a private room gives you permission to get handsy, Master.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，别以为跟您单独待在一个私密房间里，您就有主动动手的权限了，Master。

lines.en: : I have absorbed some of Osako-chan’s strength through sheer willpower, so you’d be in serious trouble if you actually tried anything.
lines.zh: : 我靠纯粹的意志力吸收了一部分 Osako 酱的力量，所以您要是真敢乱来，麻烦可就大了。

lines.en: scene black
Uta’s second wind turns into a tornado, ripping her from her place at the table and sending her crashing through a door in the side of the room.
lines.zh: Uta 的第二阵劲头化作一阵龙卷风，把她从桌边的位置上扯起来，推着她撞开了房间侧面的一扇门。

lines.en: I get caught up in it as well and follow her through an opening I imagine no man has ever moved through- into a place filled with wonder and mystery...
lines.zh: 我也被卷了进去，跟着她穿过一道我猜从来没有男人穿行过的开口——进入一个充满惊奇与神秘的地方……

lines.en: scene utabeforerain14
And that place is just a kitchen.
lines.zh: 而那个地方，只是一间厨房。

lines.en: : Our first out of a whopping {i}two{/i} stops on this official, Uta-chan sanctioned tour of the maid cafe is the kitchen! Or, as I like to refer to it, the place where wishes come true!
lines.zh: : 这场由 Uta 酱亲自认证的女仆咖啡厅官方参观，全程足足有{i}两{/i}站，第一站就是厨房！或者按我喜欢的说法，愿望成真之处！

lines.en: : I don’t think any of my maid-related wishes involve a kitchen.
lines.zh: : 我想我跟女仆有关的愿望里，可没有一个是牵扯厨房的。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you’re a pervert. But there are plenty of people who are happy just receiving attention and food from us!
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为您是个变态。不过有很多人光是从我们这儿得到关注和食物就很开心了！

lines.en: : It isn’t weird to want to be cared for! And it isn’t weird to want to care {i}for{/i} people either!
lines.zh: : 想被人关心并不奇怪！想{i}关心{/i}别人也一样不奇怪！

lines.en: scene utabeforerain15
: Just look at me! I love what I do. I love making people happy. I just also love all of the money I can make {i}while{/i} doing that.
lines.zh: : 看看我呀！我热爱我的工作。我喜欢让别人开心。我只是也喜欢{i}在{/i}做这些的同时赚到的所有钱。

lines.en: : So, if you ever decide to be a little less of a pervert and can come up with some kinda kitchen-related wish that doesn’t involve bending me over the rice cooker, just let me know!
lines.zh: : 所以，要是您哪天决定少变态一点，能想出一个跟厨房有关、又不用把我按在电饭锅上弯下腰的愿望，尽管告诉我！

lines.en: : What about the counter?
lines.zh: : 那柜台呢？

lines.en: : No wishes at all involving the defilement of Uta-chan’s purity.
lines.zh: : 任何牵扯到玷污 Uta 酱纯洁的愿望都不行。

lines.en: : For someone so pure, you come across as annoyingly evil in the face of my perversions, you know.
lines.zh: : 一个这么纯洁的人，面对我的变态心思时却表现得如此恶劣，真让人火大，您知道吗。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain16
: Oh? Well, luckily for you, our next stop is the perfect place to indulge in those perversions, Master. Or at least it would be if I weren’t accompanying you.
lines.zh: : 哦？那您运气不错，我们下一站正是纵情于那些变态心思的绝佳地点，Master。至少在我不陪着您的情况下会是。

lines.en: : But, if you’d like some time alone to truly {i}indulge{/i} in what many others have only dreamt of, I suppose I might be able to step out for a little while.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果您想单独待一会儿，真正{i}尽情享受{/i}一下别人只在梦里见过的东西，我想我也许可以出去一会儿。

lines.en: : This sounds much better than a kitchen.
lines.zh: : 这听起来比厨房好多了。

lines.en: : Yes. It’s much more suited to the tastes of a creepazoid like you.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这更适合您这种变态怪胎的口味。

lines.en: scene black
Once again, a gust comes and sweeps us away.
lines.zh: 又一阵风刮来，把我们卷走。

lines.en: The sweet scent of pastries vanishes along with the bright fluorescent light of the kitchen and is replaced by one much more stale and much more dim.
lines.zh: 甜点的香甜和厨房明亮的日光灯一同消失，取而代之的是一盏昏暗得多、也更显陈旧的灯。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain17
A room full of lockers. Lockers which likely contain the clothes and personal belongings of the cafe’s entire (Albeit very limited) staff.
lines.zh: 一屋子储物柜。这些柜子里大概装着咖啡厅全体（虽说人数很有限）员工的衣物和私人物品。

lines.en: The important thing, however, is that this staff contains Uta. Which means that Uta routinely undresses in this very room.
lines.zh: 不过重要的是，这群员工里有 Uta。也就是说，Uta 经常就在这个房间里换衣服。

lines.en: Which means that I must now prevent myself from getting an erection and inadvertently disproving her earlier statement about overcompensation.
lines.zh: 也就是说，我现在必须忍住不勃起，免得一不小心推翻了她先前关于「找补」的那番话。

lines.en: In other words, this is much better than the kitchen.
lines.zh: 换句话说，这地方比厨房好太多了。

lines.en: : Welcome to the locker room. Or, as I like to refer to it, the {i}other{/i} place where wishes come true.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到更衣室。或者按我喜欢的说法，{i}另一个{/i}愿望成真之处。

lines.en: : This is definitely much closer to what I would wish for.
lines.zh: : 这确实离我想要的东西近多了。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain18
: Well, you sure as heck aren’t the only one. Because I’m pretty sure Osako-chan and Miss Watabe get it on in here at least once a week.
lines.zh: : 嗯，您肯定不是唯一一个这么想的。因为我敢说 Osako 酱和 Watabe 小姐至少每周在这儿搞一次。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t happen to be hiding any cameras in here by any chance, would you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会在这儿藏了什么摄像头吧？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain19
: Nope! So if you were to go really crazy and take Uta-chan for yourself right now, nobody would ever know.
lines.zh: : 没有！所以就算您现在彻底发疯、把 Uta 酱占为己有，也不会有任何人知道。

lines.en: : That is...not something you should be saying to me.
lines.zh: : 这话……您不该对我说。

lines.en: : Why not? You were already thinking it, weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 为什么？您本来就在想这个，不是吗？

lines.en: : That has nothing to do with whether or not that’s something that should be said out loud, though.
lines.zh: : 可这跟那句话该不该说出口，是两回事。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain20
: Master, please. You’re making it sound as if I’m not already aware of how badly you want to watch me undress right now.
lines.zh: : Master，拜托。您说得好像我不知道您现在有多想看我脱衣服似的。

lines.en: : This {i}would{/i} be the place to do that, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟这里{i}确实{/i}是干那事的地方。

lines.en: : It {i}would{/i} be...under normal circumstances.
lines.zh: : {i}确实{/i}是啊……在正常情况下。

lines.en: : And I’m assuming normal circumstances are when I’m not here?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，所谓正常情况就是我不在这儿的时候？

lines.en: : Correct!
lines.zh: : 答对了！

lines.en: scene utabeforerain21
: But also, I spilled soy sauce all over my street clothes earlier and I don’t want to change back into them now because it would be embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 不过还有，我早些时候把酱油洒了一身便服，现在不想换回去，因为那样太丢人了。

lines.en: : More embarrassing than being dressed as a mildly risque maid?
lines.zh: : 比穿成这样一身略显暴露的女仆装还丢人？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain22
: Is taking the sleeves off really all it takes to make this getup mildy risque? They’re just sleeves.
lines.zh: : 把袖子拆了，这套衣服就真的算是略显暴露了吗？那不过是袖子而已。

lines.en: : You’d be very surprised at what even the mildest of wardrobe changes are able to accomplish.
lines.zh: : 你会很惊讶，哪怕是最细微的一点穿着变化，能造成多大的效果。

lines.en: : Boy brains are silly. You could take off your whole shirt right now and I probably wouldn’t even feel a thing.
lines.zh: : 男生的脑子真傻。您现在就是把整件衬衫脱了，我大概也不会有什么感觉。

lines.en: : Want me to try?
lines.zh: : 要我试试吗？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain23
: I mean...this {i}would{/i} be the place to do it.
lines.zh: : 我是说……这里{i}确实{/i}是干这事的地方。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain24
: But nope!
lines.zh: : 不过，不行！

lines.en: : Wanna know what you {i}can{/i} do, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，想知道您{i}能{/i}做什么吗？

lines.en: : Help you take the rest of your costume off? Deal. Great end to the tour, Uta. So glad I didn’t have to {i}actually{/i} pay for this.
lines.zh: : 帮您把剩下的戏服脱了？成交。这趟参观的收尾真棒，Uta。真高兴我{i}其实{/i}不用为这个付钱。

lines.en: : Not quite! What I’d have you do is actually even better than that!
lines.zh: : 不完全对！我要让您做的事，其实比那个还好！

lines.en: : That isn’t going to be true, but tell me what it is anyway.
lines.zh: : 这话肯定不实，不过您还是说说看吧。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain25
: Can you maybe walk me home?
lines.zh: : 您能不能……送我回家？

lines.en: : Even if there aren’t many men around here, a journey through the dark in a maid outfit is {i}probably{/i} gonna attract some negative attention.
lines.zh: : 虽说这一带男人不多，但穿着女仆装走夜路，{i}大概{/i}还是会招来些不怀好意的目光。

lines.en: : Just wear the clothes you spilled stuff on. It’s not a big deal.
lines.zh: : 那就穿那身你洒了东西的衣服呗。没什么大不了的。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain26
: But then people are going to think I’m a slob!
lines.zh: : 可那样别人会以为我是个邋遢鬼！

lines.en: : I don’t mean to offend you, but I have seen your room and that statement might not be as untrue as you think it is.
lines.zh: : 我无意冒犯，可我见过你的房间，那句话也许没你想的那么不属实。

lines.en: : You knowing is different than random people knowing!
lines.zh: : 您知道和随便什么人知道，那可不一样！

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because...I said so! That’s why!
lines.zh: : 因为……我说了算！就因为这个！

lines.en: : Are you gonna walk me home or not?!
lines.zh: : 您到底送不送我回家？！

lines.en: : Depends. Are you going to stay in character the whole time?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你会全程保持人设吗？

lines.en: : Do I...have to? Or can I maybe just be normal Uta who just happens to be cosplaying as Uta-chan?
lines.zh: : 我……非得这样吗？还是说我可以就当普通的 Uta，只不过刚好在 cosplay 成 Uta 酱？

lines.en: : You can be whichever one you are right now. The blushing is cute and I would like to see more of it.
lines.zh: : 你现在是哪一种都行。你脸红的样子很可爱，我还想多看点。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain27
: B-Blushing? But I’m not- wait, what the heck? Why is my face so hot?
lines.zh: : 脸、脸红？可我没有——等等，怎么回事？我的脸怎么这么烫？

lines.en: : Beats me. Maybe you’re just flustered because you’re holding yourself back from tackling me again?
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。也许你只是因为忍着不再次扑倒我而慌了神？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain28
: For the last time, we fell! I didn’t tackle you!
lines.zh: : 我最后说一次，我们是摔倒了！我才没有扑倒您！

lines.en: scene black
: Right, right. The falling part is still a little hazy to me. All I really remember is how we almost kissed.
lines.zh: : 对对。摔倒那部分我还有点模糊。我只记得我们差点就亲上了。

lines.en: : We...did not! That never happened!
lines.zh: : 我们……才没有！那根本没发生过！

lines.en: : Are you going to stay in the locker room all night? Or am I going to walk you home now?
lines.zh: : 你打算在更衣室里待一整晚？还是我现在就送你回家？

lines.en: : You can obviously walk me back to- wait. I still haven’t mopped. Or...really done anything to close the store yet.
lines.zh: : 您当然可以送我回——等等。我还没拖地呢。或者……打烊的活儿我其实一样都没干。

lines.en: : Just let whoever the opener is take care of it. I’m sure they won’t mind.
lines.zh: : 让明天开门的人去弄吧。我肯定他们不会介意的。

lines.en: : Guh. You don’t know the first thing about this line of work, do you?
lines.zh: : 唔。您对这行一窍不通，是吧？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain29
: Thanks for walking me home again, Sensei. I’d feel a little bad about getting you to do this all the time if you weren’t so obsessed with me.
lines.zh: : 又麻烦您送我回家，谢谢您，Sensei。要不是您这么迷恋我，我还会因为老是让您干这事而有点过意不去。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re not the one who’s obsessed with {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你确定迷恋{i}我{/i}的人不是你自己？

lines.en: : If I’m so obsessed with you, how come I’m in the bottom ten of Uta-chan’s official harem ranking?
lines.zh: : 要我真那么迷恋您，那我怎么会排在 Uta 酱官方后宫排行榜的倒数前十？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain30
: Probably because you won’t let yourself get any higher when you know you could.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你明明可以排更高，却不肯让自己上去。

lines.en: : Or because you’re not {i}actually{/i} interested in me and are just overcome by curiosity and hormones.
lines.zh: : 或者因为你{i}其实{/i}对我没兴趣，只是被好奇心和荷尔蒙冲昏了头。

lines.en: : Wha...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : What’s with that really {i}real{/i} answer all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然来了个这么{i}认真{/i}的回答？

lines.en: : Are we still joking around or, like...are we actually talking now? Cause I wasn’t ready for that mood swap.
lines.zh: : 我们还在开玩笑，还是说……现在是认真在聊？因为这气氛转得我一点准备都没有。

lines.en: : Either one is fine.
lines.zh: : 哪种都行。

lines.en: : It’s just a little exhausting having to deal with people who are always hiding things.
lines.zh: : 只是跟总是藏着东西的人打交道，有点累。

lines.en: : You...
scene utabeforerain31
: Hah...
: This is exactly why Io likes you so much, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，Io 会这么喜欢您，就是因为这一点。

lines.en: : Io likes me because I just happened to be there when she {i}wanted{/i} to like someone. That could end just as quickly as it started.
lines.zh: : Io 喜欢我，只是因为在她{i}想{/i}喜欢上什么人的时候，我刚好在场。这种事结束得可能跟开始一样快。

lines.en: : That’s a good point, I guess. I don’t think it will, though. She’s pretty attached now.
lines.zh: : 这话说得有道理吧。不过我觉得不会。她现在已经很依恋您了。

lines.en: : Are you attached as well?
lines.zh: : 你也依恋我吗？

lines.en: : To Io?
lines.zh: : 依恋 Io？

lines.en: : To me.
lines.zh: : 依恋我。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain32
: Do you have any interest in visiting Nara one day, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 您有没有兴趣哪天去奈良看看，Sensei？

lines.en: : Is that you just dodging my question?
lines.zh: : 你这是在躲我的问题？

lines.en: : Does answering like that mean you’re dodging {i}mine?{/i}
lines.zh: : 您这么回答，是不是在躲{i}我的{/i}问题？

lines.en: : Even if I was interested, it’s not like we can go anywhere. The city’s still closed off.
lines.zh: : 就算我有兴趣，我们也哪儿都去不了。这座城还封着呢。

lines.en: : But it won’t be that way forever, right? Especially now that we’re gettin’ like, actual news about the space war that I forgot was even a thing.
lines.zh: : 可也不会永远这样吧？尤其是现在我们居然收到了关于那场太空战争的真消息——我都忘了还有这回事。

lines.en: : Just hearing about who died and who didn’t isn’t exactly {i}news.{/i}
lines.zh: : 光是听说谁死了谁没死，算不上什么{i}消息{/i}。

lines.en: : Then...in a perfect world, without any space war and without any barrier, would you ever want to see where I come from?
lines.zh: : 那么……在一个没有太空战争、也没有结界的完美世界里，您会不会想看看我长大的地方？

lines.en: : Would I be going with you? Or by myself?
lines.zh: : 是跟你一起去？还是我一个人去？

lines.en: : Whatever...you’d prefer...
lines.zh: : 随便……看您更想怎样……

lines.en: : Then sure.
lines.zh: : 那就去。

lines.en: : It just sucks that probably won’t ever happen.
lines.zh: : 只可惜这大概永远不会发生。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Yeah, that does suck.
lines.zh: : 是啊，确实挺可惜的。

lines.en: : I’d like to take you there one day. And not just on an official Uta-sanctioned tour.
lines.zh: : 我想有一天带您去那儿。而且不只是走一趟 Uta 官方认证的参观路线。

lines.en: : Like...{i}actually{/i} take you.
lines.zh: : 就是……{i}真的{/i}带您去。

lines.en: : To show you what I grew up with.
lines.zh: : 带您看看我是伴着什么长大的。

lines.en: : Because the more time I spend with you, the more I want you to, like...actually know stuff about me.
lines.zh: : 因为跟您待得越久，我就越想让您……真的了解一些关于我的事。

lines.en: : It just sucks because the only things I can think of telling you would make you like me less.
lines.zh: : 只可惜，我能想到的能跟您说的事，只会让您更不喜欢我。

lines.en: A silence spreads itself between us.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默在我们之间蔓延开来。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain33
It is promptly killed by something that disagrees with its existence.
lines.zh: 它很快就被某个不同意它存在的东西杀死了。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain34
: Jeez! That scared the heck out of me.
lines.zh: : 天哪！吓死我了。

lines.en: scene utabeforerain35
: And now it’s raining too?...
lines.zh: : 现在还下起雨了？……

lines.en: : Since when does it ever rain around here?
lines.zh: : 这一带什么时候下过雨啊？

lines.en: scene utabeforerain36
: Well, we’re not just gonna stand around and wait for it to stop, are we?! I’m already low on wearable clothes and I’ve gotta work tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 我们总不能就这么站着等雨停吧？！我能穿的衣服本来就不多了，明天还得上班呢！

lines.en: : I told you to wear the other outfit, but you were insistent on not looking like a slob for all of the...zero people we have passed on the way back.
lines.zh: : 我让你穿另一套，可你死活不愿意在回来的路上……遇见的零个人面前显得邋遢。

lines.en: : Scold me later! Keep me dry for now! You’re big! You can be my umbrella!
lines.zh: : 回头再骂！先给我挡雨！您个头大！您可以当我的伞！

lines.en: : Let’s just find somewhere to go instead. That way we {i}both{/i} won't have to-
lines.zh: : 我们还是找个地方躲躲吧。那样我们{i}两个{/i}都不用——

lines.en: : Whatever! Anything is fine! Just choose a building and get inside! Hurry!
lines.zh: : 随便！哪儿都行！随便挑栋楼进去！快点！

lines.en: scene black
Uta pushes me toward the closest awning to try and shield us from the rain, but it’s to no avail as the wind rages on and ensures that we remain in peril.
lines.zh: Uta 推着我往最近的雨棚那边去，想替我们挡雨，可一点用都没有——风越刮越猛，硬是让我们继续处在险境里。

lines.en: It isn’t until we finally find a building that isn’t locked a good ten minutes later that we are finally safe...
lines.zh: 直到整整十分钟之后，我们终于找到一栋没上锁的建筑，这才算是安全了……

$ uta_love += 1
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]！{/i}
